hypothesis: Uncatalogued faults off the H19-5 support leave 1 m lidar scarp morphology; ranking off-support dots by a lidar scarp consensus earns hidden-fault credit where the 0.2778 construction has none.
mechanism: Quaternary normal-fault scarps: a linear break in slope with a steep free face, a convex crest and a concave toe (rank mean of 7 lidar_scarp_features_u8 operators); INGENIOUS used UAV lidar for exactly such new traces.
non_fault_mimic: Pluvial Lake Lahontan shoreline benches and wave-cut risers, fluvial terrace risers and fan-incision banks, and road cuts/canal banks all produce linear slope breaks with the same profile.

hypotheses_considered.name: Lidar scarp-morphology consensus
hypotheses_considered.layers: lidar_scarp_features_u8 (ex_max, step_max, lapneg_max, lappos_max, downface_max, upface_max, cross_max); 3DEP-derived, competition data pack
hypotheses_considered.signature: Linear slope break with free face, convex crest, concave toe
hypotheses_considered.why_uncatalogued: Young, small-offset scarps below the mapping scale of the USGS Qfault database are visible at 1 m (INGENIOUS Lund North UAV lidar)
hypotheses_considered.differs_from_repo: Earlier lidar lanes (GEMSDOE7/64/66) used single operators as dense surfaces; H78 uses a 7-operator consensus only to rank OFF-support dots inside a uniqueness-capped allocation
hypotheses_considered.gain_over_cost: highest (+0.01 to +0.02 hoped / 1 field, cached data)
hypotheses_considered.outcome: E1 negative (LOO dMSE < 0), E2 negative, E3 holdout below champion construction

hypotheses_considered.name: Geothermal manifestation proximity
hypotheses_considered.layers: GDR 1391 (INGENIOUS regional compilation, DOI 10.15121/1881483, CC BY 4.0): well and spring temperatures
hypotheses_considered.signature: Hot/warm wells and springs sit on permeable fault intersections and step-overs
hypotheses_considered.why_uncatalogued: Fluid upflow marks blind faults that have no scarp
hypotheses_considered.differs_from_repo: No family repo used thermal-manifestation distance to place dots
hypotheses_considered.outcome: E1: zero weight; E2: unordered, not live-supported

hypotheses_considered.differs_from_repo: Spatially varying off-support credit; the family assumes one global rate
